headline: Sales rise on the quarter but profit falls from a year ago
summary_short: Triveni Turbine revenue was ₹491 crore, down 3.0% y/y and up 10.9% q/q, with net income of ₹53.3 crore, down 41.6% y/y.
summary_long: EBITDA was ₹85.5 crore versus ₹133.0 crore a year ago, and net income rose 4.3% q/q from ₹51.1 crore. Prior-quarter figures on the shard match the company's reported Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹442.7 crore and profit of ₹51.1 crore.
